name: Affirmed AI
description:
Affirmed.ai is a multi-tenant security vulnerability management platform.
This connector lets Claude:

- Query live security findings, filtered by severity or CVE
- Browse your endpoint inventory (hosts, paths, protocols, linked findings)
- Import scan files from tools like Trivy, Burp Suite, SARIF, and Semgrep
- Check the processing status of an in-progress scan

Findings are only ever pulled from your own Affirmed account — Claude is
instructed to report only what these tools return and never invent or
guess vulnerability data.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Affirmed AI to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Affirmed AI to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app-backend.affirmed.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Affirmed AI MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Affirmed AI provides these MCP tools: check_scan_status, get_endpoints, get_findings, and upload_scan_file.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Affirmed AI?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Affirmed AI in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.

_published_faq.name: Does Affirmed AI MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Affirmed AI requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Affirmed AI is developed by Affirmed AI. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
